{{Wireless adapter |brand=Edimax |model=EW-7612UAn |revision=v1 |asin=B00F9OKKIE |fcc_date=08/28/2009 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=Yes |availability=common |if=USB |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type=Male A |form_factor=micro dongle (w/ large antenna) |vendor_id=0bda |device_id=8172 |id_string= |fcc_id=NDD9576120904 |chip1_brand=Realtek |chip1_model=RTL8191SU |addl_chips= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=1 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=80:1F:02 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} :Notes the product name as ''Xtreamer 11n''. *{{WiFiCert|WFA8055|11/04/2009}} ===Review of Linux Compatibility=== [http://m.linux-hardware-guide.com/2014-04-07-edimax-ew-7612uan-wifi-usb-adapter-300mbits-802-11n Edimax EW-7612UAn] is a USB WiFi stick, which is available in two different versions, :both of them using a different chipset and hence needing different drivers. ====Version V1: 0bda:8172==== The version V1 of the EW-7612UAn bases on the Realtek RTL8191SU chipset :and has the USB ID: '''0bda:8172''': Bus 001 Device 006: ID 0bda:8172 Realtek Semiconductor Corp. RTL8191SU 802.11n WLAN Adapter The stick is supported under Linux by the kernel module [http://linuxwireless.org/en/users/Drivers/rtl819x rtl819x]. :Alternatively, the driver provided by [http://www.edimax.com/images/Image/Driver_Utility/Wireless/NIC/EW-7612UAn/7612_22_Linux_Driver.zip Edimax for download] can be used. :However, this driver has to be compiled and installed by hand. ====Version V2: 7392:7822==== The version V2 of the EW-7612UAn bases on the RTL8192SU (RTL8192CU ?) chipset :and has the USB ID: '''7392:7822''': Bus 001 Device 006: ID 7392:7822 Edimax Technology Co., Ltd There is no driver integrated in the Linux standard kernel for this stick until now. :Therefore, one has to download the [http://edimax-de.eu/images/Image/products/EW-7612UAnV2/RTL8192CU_linux_v3.0.2164.20110715_EDIMAX%20EW-7612UAn%20V2.zip driver from the Edimax homepage]. The configuration and installation of the driver is explained in detail at [http://blog.unterhaltungsbox.com/ew-7612uan-v2-unter-debian/ blog]. :The following steps have to be executed in order to install the RTL8192 driver: {{SCollapse|RTL8192SU/CU driver | 1. The RTL8192SU driver package needs to be downloaded: 
wget http://blog.unterhaltungsbox.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/05/RTL8192.zip
2. The tools unzip and nano are needed for the installation. These tools can be installed by apt-get install unzip nano 3. Afterwards, the downloaded archive can be unzipped: unzip RTL8192.zip 4. and the included archive can be unpacked: cd RTL8188C_8192C_8192D_USB_linux_v3.4.2_3727.20120404/driver/ tar xfvz rtl8188C_8192C_8192D_usb_linux_v3.4.2_3727.20120404.tar.gz 5. In order to change the souce code files, one should change to the following directory: cd rtl8188C_8192C_8192D_usb_linux_v3.4.2_3727.20120404/include/ 6. and has to change the file osdep_service.h nano osdep_service.h and add after the lines #include #include the following include command: #include This means, that the file should look like the following: #ifndef __OSDEP_SERVICE_H_ #define __OSDEP_SERVICE_H_ #include #include #include 7. Finally, the driver can be compiled and installed cd .. make clean make sudo make install 8. The compiled kernel module 8192cu can be loaded by modprobe 8192cu }} ===See also=== *[[Edimax EW-7612UAn]] v1 • [0bda:8172] (RTL8191SU) *[[Edimax EW-7612UAn v2]] • [7392:7822] (RTL8192SU/CU) *[[Edimax EW-7612UTn]] • [0bda:8172] (RTL8191SU) ===Wireless Adapters (USB)=== {{#ask:[[Category:Wireless adapter]] [[Brand::Edimax]] [[Model::~EW*]] [[Chip1_brand::~*R*l*k*]] [[Interface::~*USB*]] [[Supported 802dot11 protocols::~*]] |?Interface |?Maximum bus version supported |?Form factor |?Supported 802dot11 protocols |?Manuf |?Chip1 brand |?Chip1 model |?Vendor ID |?Device ID |?MIMO config=MIMO |?FCC approval date#ISO |?ASIN |?Estimated date of release#ISO |?FCC ID |?Wi-Fi certification ID |?Interface connector type |?Antenna connector |?Flags |?Country of manufacture |?Has images |?OUI |format=template |introtemplate=Template:11ac ADP table intro2 |template=Template:11ac ADP table entry2 |outrotemplate=Template:GenTableOutro |limit=500 |link=all |sort=Page name |headers=show |searchlabel=… further results }} __NOTOC__
